Body.Content:
What and Why:

We are making a change to how SharePoint site logo URLs are maintained in search metadata to improve search indexing efficiency and reliability.

Going forward, changes to a SharePoint site's logo URL will no longer automatically update the SiteLogoUrl property on individual files and other items within that site.

Rollout Schedule:

General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in early December 2026 and expect to complete by early March 2027.

Impact on Your Organization:

The SiteLogoUrl property will continue to be maintained for SharePoint sites. Individual items may retain a previously indexed SiteLogoUrl value, even after the site's logo changes. Applications or custom solutions that retrieve this property from individual items through search APIs may receive an outdated value.

Action Required/Recommendations:

In the unlikely case that your organization uses the SiteLogoUrl property from individual search results, we recommend retrieving the current site logo directly from the associated SharePoint site instead. No action is required if your organization does not rely on this property.

Compliance considerations:

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.

Details.Value: SharePoint will change how site logo URLs are updated in search metadata, stopping automatic updates of the SiteLogoUrl property on individual items. Rollout is from December 2026 to March 2027. Organizations using this property in search results should retrieve logos directly from the site instead.
